relations.rationale: Vik's late arrival has no bearing on Finn restocking shelves with honey.
Vik setting down butter is unrelated to the ovens crackling.
Vik carrying a crate of butter has no bearing on the baker asking him to watch the timer.
Vik's actions with flour and butter have no bearing on Milo's height.
Setting down a crate and wiping counters are both plausible actions by Vik but neither implies the other.
Finn bringing a first-aid kit is unrelated to Finn restocking honey jars.
Milo strolling in last is consistent with and supports the depiction of him then greeting everyone and checking trays.
Milo arriving last supports the claim that Vik arrived before Milo.
Milo checking bread trays is a separate action from reaching a high shelf, though both describe Milo's activity, they don't imply each other.
Bo and Rosa being in the same study group, combined with no info on Vik, doesn't determine Rosa and Vik's group; but on its own, A doesn't establish B.
Bo being in the same group as Rosa doesn't establish anything about Bo and Vik's group relation.
The ovens crackling steadily sets a bakery scene consistent with the baker calling out instructions, supporting the plausibility of an active bakery.
The baker calling out instructions about dough supports the idea that the baker also gives Vik specific instructions like watching the timer.
The baker's instructions about dough have no bearing on Milo's height.
The baker calling instructions fits with the busy morning atmosphere described, supporting the general scene.
The baker's request to Vik about the timer is unrelated to Milo's height.
The baker asking Vik to watch the timer is unrelated to Milo reaching a high shelf.
The baker's instruction to Vik about the timer doesn't relate to the arrival order of Vik, Bo, and Milo.
Being asked to watch the timer doesn't imply or preclude Vik also wiping counters.
Rosa being in the same study group as Vik, if Bo is not in that group, supports the claim that Bo is not in the same group as Vik.
